senses: to disgrace, dishonour, be lightly esteemed, be dishonoured, be despised
(Niphal) to be dishonoured, be despised, be lightly esteemed
(Hiphil) to treat with contempt, dishonour, treat shamefully

strongs.def: to be light (as implied in rapid motion), but figuratively, only (be (causatively, hold) in contempt)
strongs.kjv: base, contemn, despise, lightly esteem, set light, seem vile
